relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - extraction-layer (used on search:coordinator-node's own promotion source page, but not itself among the 104 promoted predicates)
relations.evidence: When one particular Search Service node is chosen for a search request, it assumes the role of _coordinator_; and is thereby responsible for applying the search request to the other Search Service nodes and for gathering and returning results.

notable_absence.finding: No mention of gRPC as the scatter transport, unlike server/8.0/search/search-index-architecture.json which states the coordinator uses gRPC to scatter to other partitions. This older page describes the same mechanism one layer more abstractly and never names the wire protocol.
